SHENZHEN, China, Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Huize Holding Limited ("Huize" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: HUIZ), a leading insurance technology platform connecting consumers, insurance carriers and distribution partners digitally through data-driven and AI-powered solutions in Asia, today announced that Ron Tam, Co-CFO of Huize and CEO of Poni Insurtech, Huize's international arm, will present at the 20th Annual LD Micro Main Event, taking place October 19-21, 2026 at the Luxe Sunset Boulevard Hotel in Los Angeles, California.


Huize Holding Limited is scheduled to present on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. PT. Ron will represent the Company.


**Presentation Details**


- Date: Wednesday, October 21, 2026
- Time: 2:00 p.m. PT (Track 3)
- Location: Luxe Sunset Boulevard Hotel, Los Angeles, California
- Webcast:[https://ldmicroevents.com/](https://ldmicroevents.com/)


**About Huize**


Huize Holding Limited is a leading insurance technology platform connecting consumers, insurance carriers and distribution partners digitally through data-driven and AI-powered solutions in Asia. Targeting mass affluent consumers, Huize is dedicated to serving consumers for their life-long insurance needs. Its online-to-offline integrated insurance ecosystem covers the entire insurance life cycle and offers consumers a wide spectrum of insurance products, one-stop services, and a streamlined transaction experience across all scenarios. By leveraging AI, data analytics, and digital capabilities, Huize empowers the insurance service chain with proprietary technology-enabled solutions for insurance consultation, user engagement, marketing, risk management, and claims service.


For more information, please visit[http://ir.huize.com](http://ir.huize.com/) or follow us on social media via LinkedIn ([https://www.linkedin.com/company/huize-holding-limited](https://www.linkedin.com/company/huize-holding-limited) ), X ([https://x.com/huizeholding](https://x.com/huizeholding) ) and Webull ([https://www.webull.com/quote/nasdaq-huiz](https://www.webull.com/quote/nasdaq-huiz) ).


**About the LD Micro Main Event XX**


The 20th Annual LD Micro Main Event will take place October 19-21, 2026 at the Luxe Sunset Boulevard Hotel in Los Angeles. Registration begins at 2:00 PM PT on Monday, October 19, followed by keynote programming and a networking reception.


Company presentations will run from 9:00 AM PT to 4:00 PM PT on Tuesday, October 20 and Wednesday, October 21. The event will feature more than 100 public companies presenting to and participating in private meetings with investors. Wednesday’s program will conclude with the LD Micro Moneyball Afterparty.


**About LD Micro**


LD Micro, a wholly owned subsidiary of Freedom US Markets, was founded in 2006 with the sole purpose of being an independent resource in the micro-cap space. Through its dynamic, investor-driven conferences and curated company exposure, LD has served as an invaluable asset to all those interested in discovering the next generation of great companies. For more information on LD Micro, visit[www.ldmicro.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ODTPP1J-pH7k7BdyNPDmQPrXj5cFDTzvmj0CnUVyn3Y7ArVO453oj6CIUVOQDVZbl-SZ21W6BB6JqJR_yx0JAPLls14ddSGIgoO0lPLyt4M=) .
